quote: Native loaded-thread override replacement requires idle status, no subscribers, direct-input eligibility, and successful shutdown. Otherwise resume can acknowledge the thread while ignoring overrides; systemError alone is insufficient.
note: The Evidence item “Configuration replacement requires observed teardown” identifies the teardown requirement for changing instructions on a failed thread, but describes ignored overrides and omits the unload-confirmation failure when a sibling keeps the server active. ClawSweeper listed no open finding, and the human comment did not address that scenario.
